requirements.quote: `forgedock intake pause|resume|status [--reason]` writes `_active.intake.paused` and the label `forge:intake-paused` on the tracker.
The watcher reads that signal from GitHub, so every host honours it; an open `release/*|train/*|hotfix/*` PR or an active ledger entry also pauses claims with no local state (I18).
A test reproduces the 2026-11-12 case and the watcher pauses within one poll; `intake pause` stops claims on a second host.
zero behaviour change and zero new GitHub writes with defaults
every control writes an audit entry
